product: Glow Recipe x Buldak Glass Balm Lip Duo
title: CUTE WARM COLOR FOR FALL!
body:
I was just wishing for a warm color addition to the Balm lineup! I LOVE the formula but a lot of the existing colors are cool-toned, and not my best.  

You might be wondering whether the flavors are too savory, but don't. Carbonara is a barely-there sweetness, and Original is a kind of floral-maple. 

Carbonara is a similar pink to Watermelon, and super wearable for everyday, ie you can apply blindly and not worry about it. 

Original is the warm brick I have been hoping for! Great color payoff, super wearable for all your fall makeup looks. 

The keychain is a cute addition, personally the Original color makes this whole set worth it.

title: The perfect gift set!
body:
I was lucky enough to get the Glass Skin Essentials kit compliments of Glow Recipe to try out in exchange for my honest opinion.  As someone who loves their watermelon glow products, this is a perfect gift set for me.

This set is great for traveling since everything comes in travel sizes with the exception of the Niancinimide Dew Drops, which is a full size bottle.  This would also be a great gift for anyone who loves Glow Recipe products or someone you want to introduce to the brand.  Everything looks so aesthetically pleasing.  

All of the products work great for people with all different skin types because it’s all gentle on your skin.  I live in the desert and have combination skin and lately slightly sensitive skin and this felt so soothing on my skin and left it looking bright, glowy, and healthy.  Everything did a great job of balancing my skin out and not making the oily parts oilier.   It works well under makeup too.

The watermelon scent is also very light and yummy (I’d totally buy it as a perfume if they ever decided to come out with one!).  

I love that the box tells you exactly where in your routine to use each product.  Everything is securely packed inside.   The cherry on top would be if they added their sunscreen as the final step in the kit, but overall I’d still say this is a perfect set and the price is very reasonable.

product: Vegan PDRN Tinted Soft Matte Lip Blur Balm
title: Impossible Lip Color
body:
I've hated lipstick my whole life, but this lip color does everything right. I always wear lip balm, but after a few days with Lip Blur, my lips are better than with my regular clear balm.  If I put it on, wait ten minutes, and then out on a little more, it does a pretty good job smoothing out all but the deepest lines (and I'm over 40, so that's a heavy lift!)
The color aspect is very forgiving, too.  Instead of wicking into the fine lines around my lips, Lip Blur minimizes and smooths them. I like the way it goes on sheer at first, and I can decide how much color I want.  
 I have fair skin in cool-to-neutral territory, but which freckles in a warm hue, so color is tricky.  The berry mauve, Own the Room, is understated and not too far from the natural color of my lips.  It's perfect for when I need to look professional for a work occasion.
Finally, as a fidgeter at work, I often have to reapply color really frequently. This color doesn't wear away in weird, obvious patches. The color sticks around pretty well, even if I have a snack and disturb the balm portion. It lets me reapply on my own timeline instead of as a need.  For something like four hours of parent teacher conferences, that's pretty important to me.

product: Vegan PDRN Tinted Soft Matte Lip Blur Balm
title: Beautiful, Lightweight Blur With a Comfortable Finish
body:
I was really impressed by how soft and lightweight this feels on the lips. The texture is very cushiony and comfortable, and despite the soft-matte finish, I don’t find it drying at all. My lips actually feel quite comfortable while wearing it.

I do see the blurring effect, although I have naturally very pronounced lip lines, so the effect isn’t as dramatic on me as I expected. The product definitely softens the appearance of my lip texture, but it doesn’t completely blur my deeper lines, and some of the product can settle into them.

I found that applying a very thin layer of lip balm underneath helped the product apply more smoothly for me without taking away from the soft-matte finish.

The shade I received is beautiful and pulls warmer/oranger on my lips than I expected, but I really like how it looks. The color is buildable and the overall finish is soft and diffused rather than looking like a traditional flat matte lip color.

Overall, I really enjoy the formula’s comfort, lightweight feel, and cushiony texture. The blurring effect is real, but because my lips have more pronounced natural lines, I don’t think I get the same level of blur that someone with smoother lips might.

title: Please Make This Moisturizer Permanent!
body:
I tried a sample of this moisturizer a few years ago from Sephora before it got discontinued. I FINALLY got my hands on a jar, and I've been using it as a night routine every three days with the Avocado Ceramide Recovery Serum. Eventually, I started using it as a reliable day routine for the winter! 💛🍌🥑💚

The Banana Souffle Moisture Cream has given me surprising results. My skin tone looked noticeably even and bright, my face felt soft and smooth, and even my acne redness calmed down. The smell was so-so, but it quickly dissipated after application. This moisturizer feels a bit more heavy and greasy, but it helped prevent my skin from drying and flaking off from the cold winter weather, which my skin does not take kindly! It definitely leaves me with a glow even in the cold!

I do recommend doing a patch test first with this moisturizer, as it can sting for some people. Easing into this moisturizer, as with any new product, will help alleviate the stinging. Overall, I recommend this moisturizer, especially if you struggle with dry/irritated skin from cold weather or in general!

To those at Glow Recipe, please keep this item for good. I don't understand why you'd permanently take away a perfectly good product that would've brought you so much more brand loyalty. If this were a subscription item, so many would subscribe to it, including me! I ended up buying 3x more jars out of pressure that these would sell out quickly and never be restocked ever again, even under popular demand. Making this an exclusive product is an insult to loyal customers who use this product regularly. It pains me to see that this brand, one that I love so much, would do this to their customers. It's honestly disappointing, and I hope you'll listen to your audience one day to bring this back along with some other discontinued products too -- permanently.

title: I said I’d never forgive you for taking this away
body:
Like I’m not even trying to be dramatic, but I’m dead serious. This one hurt the most out of all the discontinuations I’ve had to deal with as a makeup lover, makeup artist and esthetician (and that’s saying something because MAC loves to take away my faves). When I discovered this moisturizer, I was struggling with my extremely dry skin that was prone to stress acne. I also wear a full face of makeup and needed something that wouldn’t interfere with that. The banana soufflé moisturizer did it ALL - hydrated my skin perfectly for over 24h so even if I forgot to reapply, it didn’t matter. It kept my acne away for over two years straight when I was able to use it regularly. And it looked beautiful under makeup and helped add more hydration and glow to my skin. When this was taken away I legitimately cried and my skin hasn’t been acne free ever since I started having to savor it.
Like Glow Recipe genuinely hurt my feelings when I went to repurchase for the third time only to find it was gone forever. I never had the chance to stock up. I even bought an $80 freaking jar on Mercari! So I really hope they restock this a few times before abruptly ripping it away again. Honestly taking the banana moisturizer away was the biggest mistake Glow Recipe ever made. It’s holy grail for me and my dry acne prone skin. I never want to be without it again! I bought a backup for now but I’m hoping I’ll be able to snag more. It would be easier if they just brought it back though so I wouldn’t have to worry about using expired product. 
Glow Recipe, I hope that relaunching this taught you how beloved this product is and I hope you reconsider your actions of taking it away from us dry skin girlies. Not fair and I’m sorry I’m still salty about it. It even pissed me off when they would tell me to try the Plum Plump because that’s not what I wanted!! And that one pills on me even with no other product, so it’s just not for me. I will love and cherish my banana moisturizers till they’re gone forever, but I seriously hope that never happens. I even considered starting a petition over this so I’m very glad I was informed they brought it back. I can’t even describe the heartbreak I felt when it was gone!
Forever the best moisturizer I’ve ever used. Nothing else compares, and trust me, I searched for like two years now to find a replacement and I just couldn’t. The one that came CLOSE was Farmacy’s Honey Halo but it did nothing to keep my skin clear and it was a little thicker than I’d like. But I’d rather buy this one for the rest of my life.

title: So Banana Smooooth, & Hydrated!
body:
This is such a good moisturizing cream. My dry, sensitive skin loves this stuff. It has a really unique texture, but it is thick enough to moisturize throughout the night, and leave my skin feeling plump, fresh, and still well-hydrated in the morning. I use it during the day too, because it's not too heavy. My skin is dry, so I do tend to use a little more than what might be average for others. Unfortunately, this means that I do go through the product fairly quickly. I see people on YouTube putting on tiny dots of this stuff, and I just don't comprehend it. 🤯 I want to swim in it. 😅

This cream is indeed very soothing. I have had days where my skin became angry and inflamed because of outside factors, and using this cream really did help to soothe it, and tone down the redness and irritation. It is nice to have a really good, soothing, hydrating cream in your routine without any actives in it. Because sometimes you just need to use something gentle, but extremely effective, and this is the one for me.

The banana scent is delicious, and not overly artificial or overpowering, in my opinion. The glass jar is lux and beautiful. The cream sinks in nicely, but doesn't ever leave me feeling like I need to re-apply later. It leaves my skin very smooth, glowy, and feeling fresh.

I love this cream, and I definitely will repurchase. I highly recommend. I'm so glad I gave Glow Recipe a go. My skin loves Glow Recipe. The best ever, by a long shot.

body: I'm 45 years old, with sensitive, very red/ reactive, combination skin.  Since my 20s, I've been in search of a product that could tackle redness and balance my skin. When I realized Glow Recipe was selling it again for a limited time, I decided to buy two more jars- because I don't know when I'll get this opportunity again.  But I'm going to keep my fingers crossed that Glow Recipe decides to make this a permanent fixture!!

title: They’re ok…
body:
Maybe it was because I received the samples in single use envelopes but I found it messy to use these and I spilled the extra liquid all over :(  Also, I only received 2 boxes of samples so there were only 2 envelopes of each kind and while I’m happy to do the review, I do not think 2 uses are anywhere near enough to leave a DECENT REVIEW. I kept these on for like 15 minutes and I didn’t like how my skin felt after I first used these and rubbed everything in- I felt sticky or tacky and I don’t like that.  Usually, that feeling (in my experience anyways) means I’m going to start pilling if I rub my skin or use any other product and unfortunately I was right.  I only wanted to use a little bit of moisturizer and it just felt gross with all the pills of product.  I wound up having to wipe my face with a damp cloth to remove the ballies (pilling) and luckily some product did remain because my skin felt really nice and soft.  If I were to try these again (I wouldn’t buy them but…) I would maybe do less time on and follow the recommended time and I also wouldn’t try to use all the extra liquid product in the envelope.  Maybe that was the pilling issue.

product: PDRN+ Repair + Soothe Korean Toner Pads
title: Soothing and hydrating
body:
The texture of these pads and the essence/toner in them is very soothing. I have some flared up spots right now due to extreme cold and dryness where I live, and applying these was immediately soothing and hydrating. My only gripe with these is that the texture is so soft and smooth that it is very difficult to hold onto them to use as one would a traditional toning pad that you just swipe across the skin. They are definitely easier to use in the mini-sheet-mask way because you can just place them and let the product absorb. The only downside to using them this way is that the pads don’t stretch the way the ones from some other brands do (such as Anua or Mediheal), so you can’t shape them to fit a certain area better. 

Overall the toner product itself is wonderful; the only downsides are to do with the physical pad. 

I tested this product as part of Glow Recipe’s testing panel, so I received complimentary samples in exchange for my honest review.

title: 🌟 Glow Recipe Vitamin C Brightening Korean  Toner Pads Review
body:
I am officially OBSESSED with the Glow Recipe Vitamin C Brightening Korean Toner Pads for Undereye & Cheeks. First of all, these have seriously helped with my puffiness and dark spots especially under my eyes and on my cheeks. After consistent use my skin looks brighter, more awake and noticeably more even. The under-eye area looks smoother and less tired which is a huge win for me. What I love most is how refreshed my face feels after using them. There’s this instant cooling, clean feeling that makes my skin look alive without any heaviness.
I use these as part of my 2–3 step toner method and they layer beautifully. They don’t pill, they don’t feel sticky and somehow they absorb so well that it almost feels like I didn’t apply anything at all  like I just rinsed my face with water.(but obviously I didn’t) No residue, no film, no thick skincare feeling. Just fresh, hydrated skin.
They’re incredibly lightweight but still very hydrating, which can be hard to find in brightening products. My skin feels soft, smooth, and balanced every time.
Definitely will be repurchasing. 10/10 for glow, hydration, and depuffing.

title: Former Eye Cream Explorer
body: I absolutely LOVE Guava Vit C Bright-Eye Gel Cream.  When I was younger, I wasn’t worried  about hiding fine lines, but I hated waking up with  puffy eyes  in the am due to seasonal allergies, lack of enough sleep and stress.  My work was always with or in front of  people, and later included public speaking.  Like many who speak publicly, I felt self conscious and having puffy eyes didn’t help.  As I began to see the signs of aging, I noticed more lines, naturally, and then darkness under my eyes.  I have tried numerous eye creams and jells, ranging from expensive to even making my own, attempting to deal with all 3 concerns.  Often, I would end up using 3: one for puffiness, one for lines and an anti-against night eye cream. I found that the more expensive creams didn’t work better and I did not want to spend all I budgeted for skin care on my eyes.  Finally, with some skepticism, I  tried this.  It’s WONDERFUL!!!  It quickly takes away the puffiness, fades under eye darkness and really helps to smooth out even the deeper lines. It’s light weight, doesn’t sting my eyes or smear my eye make up.  I’ve noticed, in very little time, that it appears to actually be diminishing some of the deeper lines!  So, I no longer have to waste money experimenting with eye products that do not work.  This is it!  I really love Glow Recipe’s products and believe that they work well for any age group!

The tester I tried in store smelled bad, but it was obviously expired and had been on the shelf at Sephora for who-knows-how-long. The fresh bottle I received smelled just like it should based on my experience with other prickly pear–focused serums. No fragrance, no niacinamide. Great product and a future repurchase.

title: Burning Sensation and Swollen Eyes
body:
I wanted to love this sunscreen as much as I love Glow Recipe products. It smells wonderful and goes on smoothly without leaving a white cast. The UVA/UVB protection works.

I’ve used it three times and it causes a burning/stinging sensation on my cheeks and around my eyes. The last application caused the skin under my eyes and my eyelids to swell up. I don’t know what ingredient or ingredients I’m allergic too in this formulation, as I’ve used avobenzone (a common culprit in US sunscreens for chemical UVA protection that causes skin irritation) without having these side effects before. Perhaps it’s a combination of certain ingredients in this particular formulation. Since avobenzone is the only FDA approved chemical UVA protection in the US, options are limited here. If you’re not sensitive to avobenzone or other ingredients in this Glow Recipe formulation, you will probably be pleased. I’m just disappointed that I had a bad reaction to it as I generally tolerate chemical sunscreens well. People with sensitive skin should be cautious when trying this product.

title: Watermelon Flush works wonders!
body: As someone with aging, impossibly dry skin that rarely wears full make up, I was pleasantly surprised by the awesome light smell, the forgiving application and the formula itself. It is highly pigmented but not overly so. It looks so natural on my skin, hides imperfections beautifully (thank you!) and I feel like this is a truly flattering shade for a wide range of skin tones and types. I would likely try the darker shade at some point, due to the fact that my dry skin absorbs  ev-e-ry-thing. So even after primer and foundation, I usually have to apply blush a second time after waiting a short period but this blush lasted several hours after a healthy application. I did not use anything on my face except GR Plum Plump serum and cream before applying this blush. A little definitely goes a long way so I could see this bottle lasting quite awhile. That said, I would suggest reapplication later in the day for those that want wear to last throughout a longer day or a more intensely flushed beautiful look for evening. Even though my skin is fair, it has pretty warm undertones (read-hyprepigmentation and sun damage! See the before picture) but this blush shined through for me and gave me a radiant, natural flush without pores. I highly recommend this product as it is very versatile and found it to be great quality. I will make this a part of my daily or almost daily routine, I liked it that much! It is fast and easy to apply which is highly important to me as a busy mom.

title: Want a Natural Looking Flush? This Will Do!
body:
Disclaimer: I was sent a free sample of the Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dewy Flush cheek serum in shade Watermelon Flush - Soft Pink. This is the first time I have ever received a free sample from GR, so not only was I super excited to try Dewy Flush, but I’m happy to share my honest review with anyone considering this product! 

Here’s my review: When I first opened the product, I thought the container/applicator seemed pretty standard and user friendly. Since one of the products main goals is to provide a natural looking flush, I was really curious how pigmented the serum was going to be, especially since I already have relatively rosy cheeks! After putting several dots on my cheek, I patted the serum in with my fingers. It only took a few seconds for it to absorb, and afterwords my skin felt moisturized (both to the touch, and just in general). The color itself almost perfectly matches my naturally rosy cheeks, and like most Glow Recipe products I could instantly see the “Dewy Glow” effect. Looking at the ingredient list, I have a feeling if you are already using any of the GR Watermelon line, this product will fit right into your dewy skin routine!

For myself, due to how rosy my cheeks are already, I probably wouldn’t use this product unless I was putting it over a layer of foundation so that my base tone isn’t already warm and pinky. With that being said, I’m really curious how the other Dewy Flush shade (Berry Flush - Warm Berry Plum) would look! 

Nonetheless, if you are looking for a natural flush (and aren’t already starting with rosy cheeks) I think this cheek serum is totally worth a try! As someone who used to use powdered blush, I immediately prefer the serum method this product provides because it just looks so much more natural on my skin. I haven’t used the product long enough that I can speak to its claims of brightening dark spots and refining pores, but I can at least say that I’ve had the cheek serum on for several hours now, and my skin has not reacted to the product, and actually still feels moisturized! 

Is it the most amazing, life changing product I’ve ever used? No. But I think it’s still a solid Glow Recipe product and it does what it says, which is providing users with a dewy flush, and for that I’ll give it 3 stars.

title: Good for Low Makeup Days
body:
To preface, I was provided a sample of Dewy Flush in “Watermelon Flush” to test and review.

After using as my daily blush, I’ve found that Dewy Flush is very lightweight, buildable, and natural looking on the skin. I tend to flush naturally, but by applying over a tinted moisturizer I am able to better control the intensity. My results with one layer tended to be more subtle (especially on camera) as can be seen in the before and after photos, but still added a nice flush.

I’ve especially appreciated how lightweight and non-greasy the formula is as I am prone to acne and also have had sensory issues with makeup in the past. My ideal product is one I can’t feel throughout the day and Dewy Flush fits the bill.

title: Almost but not quite for me
body:
I really want to love this product - and I can't tell exactly where the problem is.

Pros:
- It has a great scent and texture. It definitely feels like a serum blush and has those classic Watermelon Glow calling cards.
- It's perfect conceptually for anyone who doesn't like wearing face makeup like foundation (one of the reasons why I personally wanted to try it!)
- There's definitely a nice light tint and glow - if you build it up
- Blends very easily on the skin and it's very easy to get it nice and even

Cons:
- Even with three dots on each cheek, I found it so hard to get the color to show up on my skin. I'm not dark, but I am olive. (You can see the attached before and after pics)
- When you do layer the serum, I find that there's a point where you hit the color pay off that you want, but the dewiness is so extreme (not in a good way)
- Color range is very limited. I like the natural berry mauve, but I'd like more darker colors with just a slightly better pay off

Overall, this product is nice, but not great for me. If you are fairer or have a more neutral undertone, I could see this being wonderful. For now, this might be an under-color for my usual blush to make it a little more naturally "glow-from-within."

body:
This is a VERY thick formula. It may be good for people with extremely dry skin, but it's too thick for me. It may also be a good moisturizer for winter or for those in regularly dry climates.

Recommendation: Use at night by itself (no serums) as the last step in your regime after cleansing & toning.

title: Rosy Glow is now a holy grail product
body: I got both colored formulas at Marshall’s and I was so blown away by Rosy that I ran back and bought two more. My skin tone is light medium peachy neutral haha, depending on the brand. At first I thought this would make me look too pink, and I tend to tone down my pink spots with yellow concealer. However, after some experimentation, I have found that the best method for me is applying two full pumps all over my face and décolletage. As it sinks in, it leaves the most amazing dewy glow without the stickiness of some other glowy products. I’ve even started using it on my hands, as that’s a telltale spot for age, and mine are kinda rough from years of hard work. I’m hopeful that the glass bottles are recyclable, but I’m a little concerned they’re not due to the paint. My only feedback would be, for a clean brand, clean up your packaging game as well. It’s nice that it’s not in plastic but I still don’t want to throw this into a landfill. I do however think I can omit several other products from my routine so I think overall it’s an improvement environmentally. I will be heartbroken if the Rosy Glow ever discontinues. I’d also love one that’s sheer gold. In my opinion the Bronze is a bit too pigment-rich, as it has to be applied more sparingly. I’d imagine it would be absolutely stunning heavy-handed on a darker skin tone. The formula has improved the tone and texture of my skin so much that I plan on doing auto-delivery. I still wish it was a bit more affordable. The Pink Tax is real!

title: Absolute best retinol treatment ever
body: I really do think I have found my skin's new favorite skin care brand. I have extremely sensitive & acne-prone skin & I have been loyal to Herbivore Botanicals for a few years now, especially the blue tansy/lapis line, and have loved their products for how gentle yet effective they are, BUT I can confidently say that I am making the switch to Glow Recipe for retinol, vitamin C, & hyaluronic acid, definitely. I have been using Glow Recipe blackberry retinol serum, along with cloudberry vitamin C toner, avocado ceramide serum,  & plum hyaluronic cream for about a month. product: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Balm SPF 45
title: Too Greasy
body:
I love GR products and always repurchase them; however I will not be repurchasing this one.
Personally, I'm not a stick sunscreen fan, but I AM a clear sunscreen/non white cast fan. I have used Supergoop and Tatcha sunscreens and liked both of their formulas so I assumed I would like this since its similar ingredients. 

However, it left my skin looking more greasy than glowy and felt uncomfortable, almost like putting oil on your face. It's nice that its clear but I think its not creamy enough which is why it gives the greasy/oily look. Not good for someone with oily skin like me. I think the "results" were good, I don't sunburn easily.

I will not be repurchasing, but maybe I should try GR liquid sunscreen.

product: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Balm SPF 45
title: No. Bring back the old sunscreen.
body:
This may be the first Glow Recipe product that I didn't really love. It's harder to apply than a lotion- the lotion I can spread around and know that I got it everywhere. I'll swipe this stick all over my face and then try and spread the product around. It feels stickier. It does give the dewy-glow though. I now have one breakout on my cheek and I wonder if it's from this, because this was the only change to my routine.

Also, because it's a stick, it's not really share-able. I don't want my friend to ask for some sunscreen and then swipe this stick all over her face, too- that just feels icky.

The old sunscreen was way better. However, this is a good option if you're worried about whitecast, because there will be none. As I understand it, this is why Glow Recipe discontinued the old sunscreen. Whitecast was never a problem for me personally using the old sunscreen.

I see others complaining about the packaging, and how there's a lot of wasted product, like at the end of a lipstick tube. I've only used it for like a week so I haven't made it that far yet, but the other reviewers are probably right about that.

Glow Recipe- it is, in fact, okay, to carry more than one sunscreen. Just because you made a new product doesn't mean that you needed to get rid of the old one. This way, people can have options depending on their preferences. Bring back the old sunscreen, please.

title: Great, but be careful with layers
body: For context, I'm a young person who very rarely wears face makeup and has genetically pretty good skin, so I can't speak much to anything skincare related to this product. My main want in sunscreen is for it to be easy to apply, and for it to not feel sticky on my skin. This product is great for the first want, since it glides on super easily and can fit into almost any purse or bag without too much hassle. Definitely makes it more enticing to put on sunscreen every day and reapply it since it's so easy to apply. For the second point however, it feels very wet to the touch and noticeably doesn't dry down if you put on the recommended 4 layers too quickly. I've found that if you put on each layer, pat it down, and let it dry before putting on the next layer it feels a lot better. This product is still really nice, but I wanted to put a warning to anyone who might have sensory issues or has an active lifestyle and sweats a lot.

Pros: dry/normal skin types will get a dewy look, glides on well, sits over other skin care without pilling, zero cast, easy reapplication (if you aren’t wearing makeup), smell is gentle and not overpowering, design is easy for carrying on the go

Cons: combo skin girlies might find themselves looking oily instead of dewy (I did in my t-zone). It doesn’t truly absorb, but rather sits on the skin leaving a petroleum-adjacent feeling mask wherever it was applied. For me this is a problem. I wear glasses, own pets, and frequent the outdoors. I find I’m constantly cleaning my glasses from smudges being transferred by the product my eyelashes pick up, and particles/debris are sticking to my face (stray pet fur, pollen, dirt, cut grass, whatever outside that’s being kicked up or blown around). I wind up touching my face and extraordinary amount every time I wear this due to wiping stuck things off me

It’s a good product with a lot of good things about it, but unfortunately for me it was a miss

product: Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Balm SPF 45
title: Be Cautious of the Niacinamide - Spot Test First!
body: Similar to another reviewer, I have never had a bad reaction to a skincare product before and have liked a lot of the other Glow Recipe products that I've tried.  I was excited to try this, but after using it once, the next day I woke up and my face looked the worst it has ever looked - Tons of red, rashy bumps along my jaw line and edges of my face. I am prone to breakouts here and there, but have never had a reaction like this. Looking online, it seems like this is a potential reaction that some people have to Niacinamide. This will definitely be a lesson for the future to try a product before using it in full, but having never had an allergic reaction before or other skin sensitivities, it didn't occur to me to do so. The product itself also seemed to be a bit greasier that I would have liked. Overall, I am definitely disappointed, but at least have learned about an ingredient to avoid in the future.

I keep my face out of the sun, but when I'm at the pool/beach, get some color everywhere else. I had a hard time this summer with my face being a few shades lighter w/o makeup. I probably won't need this much during the colder weather, but will be ordering some come spring to be prepared for those summer nights!

product: Watermelon Glow Pink Juice Oil-Free Refillable Moisturizer
title: Gorgeous Bottle, Great Scent — Just Keep the Routine Simple
body:
This one wins on presentation before it even gets to performance. The pink packaging is genuinely one of my favorites on the shelf, and the refillable design is a smart touch, especially knowing the glass bottle itself accounts for a real chunk of the retail price. The watermelon scent stands out too. There aren't many watermelon-scented skincare products out there, and fewer still that pair the scent with actual skin benefit instead of just fragrance.

As a standalone moisturizer, it performs well: lightweight, oil-free, comfortable daily wear.

One important note: this doesn't layer well with other actives. When I've used it alongside other products in a routine, I've run into irritation. It works best kept to a simple two-step routine at night (cleanser, then this). If you're managing specific skin concerns with a multi-step, active-ingredient routine, this may not be the right moisturizer to build around. But for a clean, minimal routine, it delivers exactly what it promises.

title: Excellent for dry skin
body:
This duo is excellent. I'm 54, maturing skin, recent health issues have me taking lots of meds. My skin which has been oily my whole life, is now very dry. It's sensitive too and many things cause breakouts. On the occasion I wear makeup, the papaya just melts everything away, including waterproof mascara and eyeliner, with ease. Goes on so creamy silky soft and feels really nice on the skin, add a bit of water and it "activates" turning milky white and giving that deep clean. Rinse and follow by the blueberry, just wow!
I pump less than a dime size onto my silicone facial brush, add h2o for a lovely lather and after it's all said and done, I look like I've been to the spa for a facial. Skin's so soft, moisturized and silky, I look up at the mirror to see if it's my skin or if I need to rinse more. I feels like a baby. Not drying, but sets the perfect stage to apply the rest of my Glow Recipe regimen. I use them both with or w/o makeup, as a duo and individually, great results no matter what. My gorgeous 32 y/o daughter always compliments how nice my skin is. It just glows and looks plump and healthy, esp right after a fresh wash. Try it! A little but goes a looong way 💗💜

body:
I received this as a gift from my cousin. We often hit the gym together and I noticed how smooth her skin was. She mentioned she was trying Glow Recipe and she sent over links of everything she tried. The following week she had purchased a set to gift me and it included these blurring drops.

I’ve been using the Cloudberry Bright Essence Toner and Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops by Glow Recipe for about three weeks now, and I’m genuinely impressed with the results! My skin has undergone a noticeable transformation in both appearance and texture.

The Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops are an absolute game-changer. They deliver an instant glow while working over time to refine my skin. Fine lines that I thought were here to stay now appear less prominent, and my skin feels tighter and smoother.

Both products layer beautifully together without any heaviness or greasy feeling, making them a joy to use in my routine. My skin now looks fresh, radiant, and incredibly healthy—like I’ve just come back from a spa day!

If you’re looking for products that deliver real results and give your skin that coveted glow, I highly recommend giving these a try. They’ve quickly become my holy grail products!

title: Don’t really do much for me - but cute packaging and gives you a slight glow
body:
After using the Watermelon Glow Dew Drops for about a week, I have a few things to say.

I am a young teen and I don’t wear much face makeup, just usually mascara and lipgloss. Some people use this product to mix in with their foundation, but that’s not what I did. I used it alone as a serum in the middle of my skincare routine like what some people recommend to do. After I put it on, my skin felt glowy but it did feel slightly sticky and oily even when I barely put any on. Once I put on the rest of my skincare, the glow faded and just left my skin feeling just overall gross. I am sure if you use it not as a serum, it would have better results. 

Despite that, the package was so cute and the aesthetic of the entire watermelon line is amazing. 

I feel like I am being generous with the 3 stars but if you don’t use it as a serum, I’m sure you would have a better outcome.

title: The best of the best
body:
I’m absolutely obsessed with the Plum Plump Hyaluronic Cream from Glow Recipe 💜

From the first use, my skin felt instantly hydrated, bouncy, and unbelievably smooth—like it had taken a long drink of water. The texture is dreamy: rich enough to feel nourishing but still lightweight and fast-absorbing, so it never feels heavy or greasy. It layers beautifully over serums and under makeup, giving that fresh, dewy glow all day.

And can we talk about the packaging? It’s seriously the cutest thing on my vanity. The soft lavender jar with the plum-inspired design feels luxurious and playful at the same time—very on-brand and totally aesthetic. But what I love most is the refillable pod system. Being able to simply pop in a new refill when you run out is not only convenient but also feels more sustainable and thoughtful. It’s such a smart, eco-friendly touch that makes repurchasing even more satisfying.

Overall, this cream has become a holy-grail moisturizer for me—hydrating, plumping, glow-boosting, and packaged to perfection. If you want skin that looks juicy, healthy, and radiant, this is the cream to try. ✨

After a few days, my skin felt soft again and was getting back to its old self - I can say old because I’m 78 and proud of it! I am so grateful for these Glow Recipe products. My daughter also gave me the Plum Plump serum and I’ve been using all 3. I will definitely be buying these when they run out! Thank you for healing my skin!

title: A Go-To Serum for the Winter! 🥑💚
body:
I tried a sample packet of this serum and I fell in love with it! I bought the full bottle to fully incorporate it into my routine!

This Avocado Serum is perfect for the winter! My skin has been horrible since it started getting colder where I live. My face was drying and cracking into flakes, turning my skin extremely inflamed and sensitive. This serum helped reduce my redness incredibly well, including my inflamed acne. It also evened out my skin tone and left my skin looking more lively, which was a big surprise to me! I never realized how much of a red undertone my tan skin had until I used this serum. This serum also has a nice natural scent to it!

I’ve been using this serum every 3 nights, substituting my Strawberry and Blackberry serums, for about 2 weeks to heal my skin’s surface. It has also been my go-to daytime serum to use alongside the Banana Souffle Moisture Cream to defend my skin from the harsh cold weather. I highly recommend this serum to those with dry and/or sensitive skin, especially for these winter months!

Note: I originally submitted this review on 12/15/2024 via review email, but for some odd reason it didn't appear on the website, so I am resubmitting it here as of 12/30/2024! I have been using this serum for a month now, and it's still amazing :)

title: 5 Stars
body:
I absolutely love this Ceramide Recovery with Avocado… has really helped with the redness I’ve been having difficulty with, definitely will repurchase! I def recommend it. There is a sort of tingle sensation but that makes me know it’s doing its job! Not irritating for my skin but I have experience in using retinols and more advanced chemical exfoliation. I would test it if you have sensitive skin. I did when I first began using skincare as a grown woman of 34 years old but have been using them since I was 29. I would start slow. Add a new serum, exfoliant, or anything you do not use on the reg to use every other day and see how you react. 
Remind you with some targeted serums, you may experience purging (where you break out afterwards- for instance after using a derma-roller or microdermabrasion) and you may look like a tomato for a couple of days until your skin calms down. I would recommend using Beekman’s it super gentle. Let your skin breath and calm. Take your time.

body: I absolutely love the GR Watermelon Dew Drops. They have been a staple in my skin care routine for years now. The formulation is top notch, the scent is lovely and not overpowering, it's not too thick or too runny so applying is it very easy.  The instant soothing and glow that I get whenever using right before moisturizer can't be beat. For most of my life, I had to use matte foundation because I was so oily but as my skin has matured, dry spots started forming. That's when I tried using them as a primer and lucky for me,  it worked so well that I didn't have to replace every one of my matte foundations because i don't have to worry about things looking cakey. Because of the multiple ways this can be used, I definitely recommend trying the Dew Drops out if you haven't already and I plan to keep using them for the foreseeable future (along with all of my other GR products)!

body:
✨ How Dew Drops fits into my skincare and/or makeup routine

I use Dew Drops as the last step of my skincare routine before sunscreen in the morning. On makeup days, I either apply it as a primer or mix one to two pumps with my foundation for a more radiant, natural-looking finish.

Right away, my skin feels hydrated, smooth, and lightweight without feeling greasy or sticky. It gives my complexion a healthy, dewy glow and makes my skin look more refreshed and awake.

✨ How it works under makeup or mixed with complexion products

Dew Drops layers beautifully under makeup and doesn't pill or separate. When I mix it with foundation or skin tint, it creates a sheer, luminous finish that blends evenly and looks like natural, healthy skin.

✨ Whether my makeup looks smoother, fresher, or longer-lasting when I use it

My makeup applies more smoothly over Dew Drops, and my complexion looks fresher throughout the day. It helps prevent my makeup from looking dry or cakey, especially on areas that tend to get dehydrated.

✨ How my skin looks or feels over time, especially in terms of brightness, texture, or pores

With consistent use, my skin appears brighter and more even-toned. My texture looks smoother, and my pores are less noticeable, especially around my nose and cheeks. Overall, my skin looks healthier, more hydrated, and naturally radiant.

title: Not for me. Burning, Breakouts & Irritation
body:
Immediately after using the product, I broke out on my cheeks. It felt like my skin was burning, too. I thought perhaps it was contact dermatitis with a blanket that had softener on it or something since softeners irritate my skin (albeit I never experienced burning sensations with softener), but after trying this product day & night for 2-3 days, I confirmed it was the serum. My skin is still recovering from the marks of using this product around December 16th. Thankfully it’s not too bad now.

This product may be for you, but it wasn’t for me; it’s also the first Hyaluronic serum I’ve tried so I think I’m just going to stay away from those. This was the only Glow Recipe product that made me have such a reaction.

I give it 2-stars for packaging, smell, & consistency. But the lack of stars is to heed attention for my experience in the event someone else experiences it, too.

title: Simply… the Best
body:
The Papaya Cleansing balm is the best facial cleanser I’ve ever used. For years, I faithfully used an oil cleanser by another company, thinking I’d never change products. But after watching one of James Welsh’s YouTube videos on Glow Recipe, I decided to give it a try. And I have not been disappointed. My skin is very dry, so when I use the papaya cleanser at night, I simply wipe it off with a gentle cloth or tissue. I don’t double cleanse, and I’ve have no issues because of it. Also, it takes off eye makeup, including strong mascaras, and long-wearing lip products with relative ease. 
One of the best parts of this company is the fact they give samples with purchases and offer mini/travel size products for you to try before making a huge commitment. My skin is sensitive and prone to redness and eczema, so I’m truly grateful to be to “test” first. So if you’re concerned for any reason, get a sample or a mini of this papaya cleanser and try it out.

title: My holy grail
body:
I absolutely love this product! I just got a second one before my first even ran out (there was a sale, so I figured why not stock up!) The smell is fantastic and it removes my make up and sunscreen beautifully. 

To remove heavier makeup, I spend about a minute gently massaging it over my CLOSED eyes and then rinse off the black, and then I go back and do my face. 
Usually it’s just some sunscreen, I’m currently using Make It Matte (Black Girl Sunscreen), and that comes off really easily with this balm. 

A little hack I’ve been doing- I have a mini papaya cleansing balm container, and I’ve been using a spatula to scoop some out of my full size into the mini, that way my full size stays as fresh as possible and doesn’t get contaminated with water or bacteria from opening it everyday.

title: Horrible would be zero stars
body:
I placed an order with Glow Recipe and realized immediately afterward that the shipping address had auto-filled to my old address in another state. I reached out to customer service before the order shipped, asking if they could either update the shipping address or cancel the order.

Despite the fact that nothing had shipped yet, I was told that no changes at all could be made once an order is placed – not even a simple address correction – and that my only option was to “refuse delivery.” I explained that I no longer live at that address or even in that state, so refusing delivery wasn’t possible. I would have no way to receive the products I paid for or get them returned.

Glow Recipe still refused to help, citing “policy,” but what they pointed to was simply a Q&A answer from last year, not a clearly stated or reasonable policy. They offered no solution or exception, even though this was clearly a checkout glitch and I contacted them right away. As a first-time customer, this was really disappointing.

Because they would not work with me to correct the address or cancel the order prior to shipment, I’ll now have to dispute the charge with my bank. Unfortunately, this experience has completely put me off from ordering with Glow Recipe again, and I feel other customers should be aware that if anything goes wrong with your order details, their “policy” leaves you with almost no options.

title: AHA is too strong
body: This is probably the worst cleanser I have ever tried. I thought because it was formulated and instructed to be used 2x daily the AHA would be a low percentage, however it is too high. I have never had a product so thoroughly wreck my skin so quickly, so badly, or put me is so much discomfort. After 2.5 days of use my skin barrier is completely wrecked. There are large patches of dry flaky skin everywhere, more acne than I have had in the last 5 years, and my skin can no longer hold any moisture or hydration on its own. Every product I use after causes my skin to turn red and burn for quite a while (as in I can feel my face throbbing), then after an hour it's dry and tight with the flakes coming through again like I never used a moisturizer. I even used Glow Recipe's moisturizers and those gave me the same results after using this cleanser, where as before the cleanser the moisturizers were lovely! I now have to buy the most basic moisturizer I can find at target and reapply it multiple times a day to help my skin repair, and who knows how long that will take. Please note, I have a lot of experience with AHAs, I have use many types of AHA products with wide percentages, even my body wash has AHAs. I have been using sunscreen daily whenever I go outside or need to sit in a room with lots of windows for years prior to this cleanser and continued to do so during it's use. I have an office job so I really only need to worry about my commute once a week. This result is NOT due to user error or sun sensitivity, as Glow Recipe's responses claim to others who have left similar reviews. Not only will I not recommend this product, I will tell others to avoid it until the AHA is lowered to a level that is actually safe to use twice daily.

title: My go-to for makeup removal
body:
I am obsessed with this cleanser. After using a free sample from Sephora, I was hooked! 
- It smells SO GOOD (even my husband agrees). I genuinely look forward to using it at the end of a long day.
- The texture of the cleanser is great. It's a "bouncy" gel when you pump it, and it foams up really nicely when you add water. It leaves my skin feeling nice and soft. 
- It does a great job of removing makeup! I've tried other cleansing balms that felt oily, and like it just added to gunk on my face (instead of removing everything). This cleanser doesn't give me that sensation.  
- A little goes a long way! If I have a lot of eye makeup on, I'll use 2 pumps and gently scrub my lashline to ensure I get everything off my eyes.

Highly, highly recommend... and I just signed up for a subscription, so I never run out :)

title: Long-winded but thorough if your on the fence!
body:
This is a lengthy review but worth it if you are on the fence. So I am not an influencer but I signed up for the early giveaway pr package and well luck would have it I won!! Stoked! Anyways I was a bit skeptical because I love the barrier repair but was not a fan of the oat so simple..like actually disappointed in that product. Upon receiving this pr I had actually been using the heavy duty b5 cream (la roche posay) and was perfectly content but I took a look in the mirror and decided to refresh my skincare midday. I used my mochi cream for the first time. The texture was and is beautiful, rich but not thick. Light but not thin. I felt refreshed and satin but not "dewey" or wet (side eyeing you oat so simple). It soothed the redness I had from my flushing at work. I reapplied my makeup which is very minimal but it didn't argue with anything especially around my eyes. I was suffering from some random acne and I found that it comforted them instead of trying to fight them. It also didn't conflict with my cosrx stick spf which mattifies but I still felt really satin and so comfortable. Now I've been using it everyday for almost 2 weeks and it really is my favorite part of my skincare and because of no fragrance it also pairs really well with my prescription retinol at night. Okay, so in the promos for this product by the owner Liah Yoo she made a comment that this isn't going to be like your deep freezing winter moisturizer and she's right. If you are out in minus temperature weather this alone is not it, honestly I would be comfortable saying I would layer it underneath something thicker but as a stand alone is not gonna do it (I live in a coastal city that does hit negative temps and painful winds and I work on the water so some context there). But truly this is such a unique product I think for every season, I will be curious about the summer months but autumn through spring you cannot miss, I really am excited to repurchase. Okay now for the packaging, the classic Krave Beauty; simple and interesting, utilitarian but not clinical and the texture is very much matte and has a very finely milled feeling. Tactically I'm really thrilled to hold it in my hands when I apply it or move around my get-ready space. I think of you are either incredibly dry or oily, and I mean severely, then I cannot attest for this in your routine. I am definitely on the oily side but because of my prescription retinol use (tazarotine) I'm now normal to dry, but when I take breaks I almost immediately revert to my naturally oily state. I've done both with this mochi bounce and I love it in both states of skin. No product is a one-and-done-nothing-else needed savior (maybe except the great barrier relief, would die on the sword for that one, and also a discontinued rms thing) but the mochi bounce is a really beautiful well-rounded product, from the effect it has on your skin, to the effect it leaves you through the day, the comfort it will give to your blemishes, the enjoyment from its tactile nature. I 100% want everyone to purchase this at least once...you will not be disappointed, it might not be "your" thing but disappointed you won't be. So give it a try, this moisturizer isn't making you grandiose promises but was very clearly carefully crafted and a product I hope down the line I can say is a hero-product. Long winded but I hope thorough for y'all that aren't quite ready to spend those few extra dollars. Best of luck to you all :)
 *also I received the socks and they are super cute, no logos that make you look like a walking billboard and have gotten lotsa compliments ;)

title: Plumping hydration
body:
I have sensitive, combination skin, with my main concerns being enlarged pores and breakouts. Living
in the Midwest, I struggle with oiliness in the summer and dryness in the winter, so I think it is important to note that I am testing this moisturizer during a summer heat wave. 
I have been using it every night for a week, and while my skin does appear noticeably more plump in the morning, I have noticed that my pores appear larger throughout the day. For that reason, I don’t think this is the moisturizer for my fellow combination-skin babes during the summer. I will be sticking to my GBR serum as a moisturizer for the time being. 
That said, I have a feeling my skin is going to eat this up during the fall and winter, when my skin inevitably becomes dry. The texture is bouncy and creamy, and I love that there is no added fragrance. A little bit of product goes a long way, and the packaging is sturdy and well-made.

I absolutely love the packaging of this product. The color scheme and design is amazing, and I really appreciate the matte finish of the container. Especially with using several products or layering products, my hands can be moisturized and slippery, so the matte finish of the container helps with the grip! 
I would be nice to have a plastic cover on the inside, so that when I open the container, the cream isnt immediately exposed and doesn't get onto the lid. 
2. Product
As someone with rosacea and highly sensitive skin, I love the fact that this product is unscented. It works fantastic as a single, one-step cream, and absorbs very quickly and leaves the skin feeling very moisturized. (Like all heavier creams, it does leave behind a slightly tacky finish so not everyone might be into that, but I personally have no issue with that!) 
It also really works well when layered, and layering with itself or even with other products works well. My skin doesn't feel heavy, there's no pilling of product, and even works well under sunscreen. It leaves my skin moisturized and plump, and most importantly, does not irritate my skin or trigger my rosacea!
Overall, this is a great product for those who want a one-step, simple but hydrating skincare routine, as well as for those who have a multi-step skincare routine as a last step finishing cream!

title: My favorite rich cream
body: For the past few years, I have had trouble finding a rich cream.  My skin is mostly really dry, but I struggle with oil on my forehead.  Most rich creams increase the oil on my forehead, leading to blackheads and slickness.  At the same time, most lotions do not provide enough moisture for my skin, especially in winter.  This rich moisturizer has been wonderful for my skin.  It has not increased oil production at all, in fact, my forehead has been feeling less oily in the morning (I have been using this at night, not during the day).  My skin feels soft and hydrated each morning, and I haven't had any breakouts.  I love that this moisturizer has no added fragrance.  A little goes a very long way.  I am so excited to have this product as a part of my daily routine.

title: Loved the original formula, but the new version is causing eye swelling
body:
I used and loved the original Great Barrier Relief serum for years with zero issues. About a year and a half ago, I repurchased a few bottles to restock and shortly after started experiencing intermittent eye swelling, itching, and what felt like an allergic reaction. Because I had used this product for so long, I honestly never suspected it was the cause.

Recently, I started testing my skincare products one at a time, including my face wash and moisturizers, to figure out what was triggering the reaction. Every single time I used the newer formulation of Great Barrier Relief, I woke up the next day with swelling and irritation around my eyes.

I was honestly disappointed to discover this because I truly loved this serum for years. After searching online, I also noticed many others reporting similar reactions on Reddit, which makes me wonder if something in the formulation changed. I wanted to share my experience in case others are trying to figure out the source of similar symptoms.

title: Thank you for the smelly wonderful stuff that I can't live without.
body: I have very dry skin but live in a sub tropical very humid climate. I have rosacea and have always had hand eczema.  I have many allergies and sensitives (including most fragrances and essential oils even the ones that are often labeled as good. I have tried every topical (and prescription topical) I can find as the real problem for me started 15 years ago when a severe burn that became inflamed  and stayed that way for too long caused eczema all down my neck, chest, jaw and earlobes. Things help but not for long or they only get me half way thorough the night before I am awake trying not to itch and miserable until this. This has truly been a godsend. Normally anything with a smell sends my eczema into a flare up so when I opened this for the first time not only did I think it wouldn't work and that it would flare me up but I hated the smell so walked straight to the trash bin but right before pitching it I thought about the years I've spent trying everything under the sun to find relief and how I could just put this on once it would start burning or itching I could wash it off and throw it away with a clear conscious and go on the hunt again.  I was almost glad that it wouldn't work I hated the smell so bad. So I applied it liberally all over my chest, neck, under my chin and ears thinking I'd just be headed to the shower soon to get it off.. I went to do some emails and forgot that it was on until a few hours later my husband came home and went to kiss me saying, "what is that smell have you been eating cabbage and onions?" To my surprise I realized I'd forgotten all about it and It never burned or itched.. not only did it t not flare me up but I hadn't had to keep myself from itching the why I normally did all afternoon. So I decided to try it again the next morning by that evening I realized that I hadn't had the need to scratch all day. I told my husband I was going to give it a little while that eventually it will do like anything else I've tried which so far was to give me a few days peace before it stopped working. He was not pleased as the only person who hates the smell more than me is him. By the time I finished the first bottle the ever present scratches that never seemed to heal were fading, the redness had lessoned and I sleep through the night. I'm on my 6 or 7th bottle now dong much, much better. Seriously I don't know what I'd do without this stuff however luckily I am finding I need it less and less too. I still use it as my barrier has a long way to go but I can get away with skipping a day if we are going out or for holidays without the painful burning and itchy coming along for the ride now. My husband he still has one complaint that it isn't sold in bulk at Costco. it's strange how a smell you hated can become liked when it eases so much pain and frustration.

title: Formula change? Made me inflamed and itchy
body:
I want to start by saying that I’ve used KB since 2019 and there is not a single product I have not tried. I’m a huge, long-time fan and have spent a lot of money making KB products the main line of skincare for my sensitive, dehydrated skin. 

Recently, I started getting extremely itchy and inflamed patches on my cheek and neck and I had no idea what was causing it. I thought maybe it’s seasonal allergy (I’ve never had seasonal allergy in my life) or something else I was wearing, eating, or using. When I realized nothing I was doing was showing improvement, I started taking things out of my skincare routine which hasn’t changed in years. After pausing Oat So Simple for two days, my red, itchy, and inflamed patches began to improve. To double check that it’s actually the moisturizer that was causing it, I put it back into my routine one night before bed and by next morning I was itching and burning all over again. This moisturizer has been in my routine for years and I’m devastated that it’s doing this to my skin out of nowhere. I’m not sure if there was some type of formula/other change in the production process or it was a one-time issue with a certain batch (was in the middle of using my large refill pouch). I still have one large unopened pouch left that I’m afraid to use but don’t want to throw out because that would be wasteful. It’s been a week since I stopped again and my face+neck is healing nicely and I no longer need my hydrocortisone cream to fight the itching and burning. 

If this is your first time using the moisturizer, I feel that it might be worth trying out the travel size first to patch test.

title: Great for Rosacea / oily skin
body:
Ok. My skin is a bit complicated so bear with me.  I do have Rosacea along with rosacea bumps/papules that break out at times, along with oily skin and clogged pores. This means that 9/10 times most moisturizers will break me out because they are too heavy. (Believe me I've tried so many over the years from many brands it's crazy).

This is the best moisturizing but non moisturizing moisturizer I've yet to use.  This is great for oily/sensitive/problematic skin.  The formula is light and gentle, and is still potent even if you use a drop.  It doesn't break me out, and definitely calms my skin down when I tend to have a lot of rosacea breakouts.  I rotate between this serum, the Oat so Simple Cream, as well as Ivermectin Lotion (normally for lice but I heard it help with the mites that live on your skin and can cause rosacea breakouts, which this has worked for me) during the week.

I also occasionally get eczema flare ups and I know this formula was designed for that but it definitely doesn't irritate my skin/flare ups so that's a win in my book.  (If you have complicated skin conditions you understand this).  Honestly this is now a tips and tricks review but when I do get eczema the only thing that makes it go away is putting a fat glob of vaseline all over the area and do that daily until it goes away.

I would say probably don't use this product if you have dry skin and need that thick moisturizer.  Maybe the Oil-La-La would be better for those skin concerns.  Other than that if you have problematic skin, this is the serum for you! and honestly I use this as my sole moisturizer on the days that I use it so it works well enough that you don't have to combine it with anything.

title: Kind to my sensitive skin
body:
Pros:

-Doesn't irritate my skin or break me out (this is a HUGE deal, because most moisturizers do one or both of these to my sensitive skin, so I was relieved to find this)

-Soaks in well, doesn't leave my skin sticky (I find that a lot of moisturizers just leave a sticky coating, but this one seems to dry down/soak in nicely)

Cons:
-It's not very hydrating--definitely a light moisturizer (for context, I have oily/combo skin that's very dehydrated, so it's tricky finding something that's hydrating enough that doesn't make my skin greasy--this one doesn't make it greasy at all, but it's just not that hydrating).  For me, this is a con, but if you only need a little bit of hydration, this might be a good match.  Basically, they advertise it as a "lightweight" moisturizer, and I think that's accurate.

-I'm not a fan of the packaging.  Tubs aren't sanitary (even with the tiny spatula it comes with) and are kind of awkward.  I'd prefer a pump.  I might get the large refill pouch and put it in a pump myself or something.

-I can't use it under my eyes/along my upper cheeks.  It works well for the sensitive skin on the rest of my face, but I need to keep it far away from my under eye area (including avoiding even the upper cheek).  But I have this problem with basically all moisturizers, so it's not unique to this one.

Overall:
This is my go-to option for a moisturizer that does no harm.  I keep trying other ones hoping to find something more moisturizing, but then coming back to this one because it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin or cause other problems.  I recently started my second container of it.

I'm a very happy pcos girly and mommy because when my boy starts to tackle acne I know Krave will have my back and he won't have to suffer the way I did for years. I'm very grateful to Liah and the amazing team she has. This is a company I will forever endorse and support for many years to come. Yall seriously need to give it a try if you haven't already and even if at first you are like....eh idk. Trust me. Give it time. Be consistent. You will get results! Love you Krave!

title: Great lip balm option!
body: I have a horrible habit of picking or biting at my lip when I'm anxious. Sometimes I even do it in my sleep. Before trying this, I hadn't actually done it in a while but I ended up having an anxious day and making my lip bleed. This healed it incredibly fast. I was very impressed! It's nourishing and hydrating, a little bit glossy but not sticky. I would say it's slightly thinner than some of the other formulas out there but I actually liked that. There are only 2 things that kept it from being absolutely perfect for me: 1) The wear time was a little lower than I like but I feel like it was on par with similar lip balms from Summer Fridays, Ole Henriksen, Rhode, etc. I like being able to use one lip balm for all day and night if I can. These don't quite last all night for me, including Lip Barrier Relief. I don't necessarily wake up with super chapped or dry lips but they also don't feel super hydrated like when using a lip mask such as Fenty Plush Puddin'. 2) When I first applied this after making my lip bleed, it tingled a little. Kinda reminded me of how a plumping lip gloss can sometimes make your lips tingle almost to the point of burning but not quite. The sensation faded quickly and I didn't experience it regularly. Neither of these were dealbreakers for me, and like I said, I find them common with other popular lip balms. I would repurchase based on how quickly it healed my bit lip alone! It also helped my lips feel protected when dealing with the extreme cold and wind chills we've been having in the upper midwest states.
skin_concern: Redness & Inflammation, Dark Spots, Pores, Uneven Texture, Acne

title: MY #1 ALWAYS
body:
I don’t have acne prone skin, my skin has luckily always been healthy and firm. Sadly I did damage to my poor skin by trying hyaluronic acid. I’m 37 with no wrinkles but I wanted to take preventative measures. I should have patch tested it but I didn’t, and destroyed my skin barrier by trying hyaluronic acid, my skin reacted very poorly, I was devastated. I lived in Mexico City at the time for work so my immune system was already compromised from being in a new environment. My skin was rough and showing texture. I was so worried I’d destroyed my beautiful skin. I went to several dermatologist, I used heavier night creams to protect my skin, the sica serums, but nothing worked long term, they were just crutches to mask the problem, my skin barrier never felt the same,. Until on a whim I ordered the bundle skin care line since I’m obsessed with their flagship product the Great Barrier Relief that helped my skin with lupus thanks to the seed oil. I used oil cleanser before so I was scared of drying my skin out even more, but face wash slowly and diligently helped repair my skin barrier, I was shocked! My skin isn’t where it used to be but I owe so much to Krave beauty for starting my skin on the right path, thank you so much krave. You helped me so much and as someone who cares deeply about the environment I feel great about using your products!

TL;DR krave beauty’s cleanser has helped repair my beloved skin barrier. I have very sensitive skin from lupus and all their products work wonders for my skin!

title: Received rancid product?
body:
I ordered Oil La La, hoping it would help my sensitive, acne-prone skin. Unfortunately, the product I received did not match the color of the formula in the online photos (it was white rather than light orange) and it smelled rancid. When I reached out to customer support, I was told “Rosehip oil which is one of our ingredients, naturally has a very distinct, earthy scent that can sometimes come across as slightly smoky or gasoline-like depending on the harvest, and the scent may vary slightly between batches.” I use a lot of natural oils, and I don’t believe “gasoline” is a natural scent for a fresh product.

Still, I trusted customer service and tested the product out for several weeks. It did nothing for my skin and actually increased the amount of closed comedones on my cheeks and chin (in addition to smelling terrible).

The expiration date says 8/5/2027, but I feel like it was already rancid as soon as I received it.

title: Not a replacement for GBR, but great for everyday!
body:
I’ve been a loyal user of Great Barrier Relief for years. It’s one of those products I’ve repurchased multiple times because it’s always been really reliable for my skin. When the original Oil La La first came out, I bought it pretty quickly because I was curious if it might work even better for me or possibly replace Great Barrier Relief in my routine.

For reference, my skin is slightly sensitive and acne-prone. I’m combination/oily but also a bit dehydrated, which can make finding the right balance tricky.

When I tried the original Oil La La, I noticed pretty quickly that it didn’t absorb quite as nicely on my skin. It felt just a little bit heavier and slightly more greasy than I was expecting. It wasn’t bad by any means, but it didn’t really give me the same comforting, skin-supporting feel that Great Barrier Relief does. For me personally, it just wasn’t good enough to replace Great Barrier Relief.

After trying the reformulated Oil La La, I feel like this one actually fits my skin much better, especially during the warmer months. It absorbs faster and feels lighter overall. I also feel comfortable using it over areas where I have active breakouts because it hydrates those spots well without making them feel more congested or oily.

Overall, I think it’s a really nice product. I wouldn’t necessarily say it replaces Great Barrier Relief because that product is thicker and better when your skin really needs barrier support. But as a daily serum, morning and night, especially if you’re using actives, I think this one works really well. I use tretinoin, and this layers nicely without feeling greasy.

For my skin, it’s definitely been an improvement since the original Oil La La.

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

title: Combo Skin-Hormonal Acne GAMECHANGER
body:
Oil La La (and GBR) is my HOLY GRAIL. It is the only product that has consistently worked in PREVENTING my monthly hormonal acne on my chin leading to my time of the month. I've tried applying spot acne treatment on my chin BEFORE even getting hormonal acne, but it did not work. I've tried getting facial treatment before and during my period, yet I would still get my hormonal zits.

What has worked for me was applying gentle AHA + BHA toner (Beauty of Joseon -- I have sensitive skin, but this never caused me irritation) AND Oil La La on my chin leading to my period, and it has really made all the difference! More than just not getting the monthly zits, I don't get DARK MARKS anymore from pricking them (I can't help it!).

NOTE: I've long been applying it daily, not just when I'm about to get my period. And when I'm lazy at night (happens often haha), it is my bare minimum step after cleansing.

And I would say, from combination skin, my skin type is closer to normal (and less sensitive now, thanks to GBR).

The only reason I've rated it 4 instead of 5 stars is the hit/miss consistency/texture of the serum itself. I've received bottles that weren't emulsified well, but KB has been very quick with refunds so it was never a stressful discussion with them (but I ship it from the US to the Philippines so having to repurchase, wait, and hope it's a good formula causes a lull/gap in my routine). I hope this stability/consistency can one day be solved for good. I know though that KB always tries to do things sustainably (ingredients, etc) so I'm patient with them in getting this right.

Still cannot live without it!

title: Gentle option for acne prone skin
body: I have been using Oil La La since it originally released and never want to go without it! I struggled with acne as a teenager and now have been struggling with  adult acne. I often find that “traditional” acne treatments (such as salicylic acid, benzoyl peroxide) dry my skin out and damage my skin barrier, even when I try introducing them slowly into my routine. I haven’t been able to find anything that I can use on a consistent basis until I started using Oil La La. I use it at night after the rest of my serums before moisturizer. It has never caused any reactions and my breakouts/clogged pores are lessened in the morning. I don’t find it greasy at all, but I can feel it on my skin and don’t like that feeling during the day so I skip it. I plan to always have a bottle of this on hand as long as I am dealing with breakouts and congested skin!

product: Duo Beet The Sun SPF 40 PA+++
title: When it works, it works!
body:
PROS: I used this product a couple of years ago and it was great—it withstood the Seoul July-August sun and felt moisturizing. There's no residue on the skin and it's lightweight. Another plus is the fact that there's none of the usual "sunscreen smell" or the chalky feeling that mineral SPFs can leave on the skin, both of which make my sensory issues act up. 

The cons aren't actually cons, it's totally my fault: I decided to repurchase this year and didn't patch test since I had used it before—and totally forgot that I started using Tretinoin this year, so my skin's sensitivity levels have changed. Promptly had an allergic reaction. 
Everything I enjoyed before is still the same: nice texture, no smell, etc. It just doesn't work for my skin. My bottle has been rehomed with a loving family LOL. Leaving this review to remind everyone to be mindful with new products after you start a prescription retinoid, even with products that are formulated for sensitive skin :)

product: Duo Beet The Sun SPF 40 PA+++
title: Not the EU formulation
body:
Beet The Sun has quickly become one of my favourite sunscreens! I first discovered it through Caroline Hirons’ Kit Bag and instantly loved the texture, finish, and how beautifully it sits on the skin. I am able to keep using this through my dermatitis flares which is so important to me. Beer the Sun easily rivals my long-time favourite from Purito and has become a daily essential for me.

However, I ordered directly from the brand’s website (London-based) so I could support the brand directly and I received the US formulation rather than the EU version I was expecting. I have seborrheic dermatitis and have to be careful with what I use, so I was a bit hesitant to open it. After reaching out, customer service explained the reason clearly and kindly that the site currently ships from the US and must follow FDA regulations. They even offered a refund if my skin didn’t tolerate it, which I really appreciated.

The EU version is a brilliant sunscreen, but I’d love to see an option on the website to buy the EU version since its available in my territory since it remains an excellent product that I’ll keep using.

title: Holy grail Sunscreen
body:
I have fair skin that is very sensitive and prone to sunburns, and I live in California so sunscreen on my face is a must most of the year. I have tried many sunscreens, and this one is hands-down my favorite. A lot of mineral sunscreens are too thick, greasy or sticky and leave a white cast, and most chemical sunscreens look great but burn my eyes horribly. If I really push it (i.e. reapply and sweat a lot), I might end up feeling some discomfort in my eyes, but I have experienced that with every product I have ever tried.

Just purchased my second bottle and I couldn't be happier! I hope it never goes out of stock!

body:

title: Immediate Glow; Okay with Sensitive Skin
body:
As someone with slightly sensitive skin, I am not very experimental with skincare routine. The only vit A derivate products I've used are Jordan Samuel Skin Retinol Treatment Oil (0.2% retinol only accdg to Google; was too oily for humid Philippines & personally did not notice extraordinary results) and Beauty of Joseon Revive Eye Serum : Ginseng + Retinal (0.02% pure retinal only accdg to Google -- I still use this product to this day).

While I understand that 24 Carrot Retinal only has 0.05% retinal, somehow, it gives me immediately better-looking skin the day after. Maybe it's in the formula and how easily it gets absorbed in the skin? I've only been using it 1-2x a week, and because I'm still scared of getting sensitized, I apply it on top of GBR and I apply Oat So Simple moisturizer on top.

This is just my first bottle, and I'm only on my 2nd week. But I think it will be another routine staple for me.

title: HOLY GRAIL PRODUCT
body:
I absolutely love using this product! I've been using it for about six weeks now, and I started noticing a difference in my skin at around the two-week mark. I apply it 2-3 times/week. This is the first retinal that I've used, and for the most part it felt really gentle on my skin! Below are my pros and cons:

PROS
- evened my redness 
- made my skin glowy and healthy-looking
- my acne started to clear up quickly
- once my acne cleared, there were no red marks on my skin (acne scars? I'm not sure what the correct term is)
- my mom noticed how good my skin was looking (I felt so flattered!!!)

CONS
- if you've never used a retinal before (or if you have really sensitive skin like me), it takes a bit of time for your skin to get used to it. For me, it took about 1-2 weeks. At first, it kind of burned(? I'm not sure if that's the right word) in my face and I had to fan my face to cool it down

That was honestly the only con. This product feels so good on my skin, both during application and after. My skin has COMPLETELY changed for the better since I started using this, and I highly recommend it!

I have attached before and after pictures! In the before pictures, I am wearing the white shirt (and vise versa).

title: A truly gentle retinol
body:
I used this for 4 weeks without using any other retinol, and I stopped using my normal prescription tretinoin during that time. 

I have dry, sensitive skin and get hormonal acne around my period.

However, I had a purging effect or something on this - I started getting random pimples and also closed comedones, which aren't issues I even normally struggle with. That being said, my skin is very used to tretinoin, which is very strong. 

I would highly recommend this as a starter retinol, though, especially since it did not irritate or dry out my skin.
