title: My First Retinal Experience!
body:
I've long known about the powers of retinol for anti-aging, but had yet to try any retinol products; there was always the concern about potential skin irritation. Luckily, Krave Beauty's new retinal serum proved to be completely gentle on my skin, with no resulting sensitivity.

Having tried it out for >4 weeks, I started off with using it only twice a week, and after seeing no peeling or redness, gradually increased it to every other day, then to daily nighttime use. The serum has a gel texture with orange carrot microcapsules, and was quite cooling when applied to the skin, without causing any dryness the next day after using my regular moisturizer. Surprisingly, even when applied to healing skin recovering from picking at breakouts, there was no pain.

I hoped to see a reduction in hyperpigmentation and fading of my dark spots, but I don't think this timeframe was long enough to notice any differences. Similarly, there wasn't any change in terms of wrinkle-reduction or firming. Some breakouts did still occur during use, so I wasn't sure if that was potentially purging. 

Since this serum is so gentle, I expect it would likely take more time to see differences, so I plan to finish it up and see if any improvements can be noted then. In the meantime, it doesn't seem to cause any irritation, and does feel moisturizing when used in my current routine.

title: Gentle and Effective
body:
I’d like to volunteer my background in case anyone can relate: I am a Hispanic woman, 29, with very dry skin. My concerns before trying this retinal were my skin texture, dullness, uneven skin tone. 
I’ve tried retinoids in the past and there’s always going to be an adjustment period, but it was such a quick and gentle one with this retinal. I can confidently say it’s the most beginner friendly one I have ever tried! It didn’t sting, left minimal dry spots on the beginning (normal), and at no point did I have to pause using it due to irritation. 
I LOVE the gel texture versus a thick cream because it can be easily spread and absorbed. As with any other product of this kind, it’ll take a while before you see drastic results, but I’ve already noticed my skin looks less dull and the texture has improved without me having to exfoliate. It’s also begun to lighten some dark spots and I’m excited to see an improvement in things like fine lines in the upcoming weeks. Your skin barrier will thank you for starting here.

title: Love it but not the applicator
body:
Disclaimer: Got this for free. 

I love this lip jelly—it’s one of the only two products that actually works for my crusty lips during the cold season. I use it at night as a lip treatment, and I wake up with plump, well-moisturized lips. The consistency isn’t too thick or sticky, which I really love.

The only downside is the applicator—it doesn’t pick up enough product. I have slightly fuller lips, so I have to dip it 3–5 times to fully cover them. But will I repurchase it? Definitely yes. I also appreciate that I can just buy the refill too.

title: Great formula, but ultimately unusable
body:
I was so excited for this launch that I ordered the product in 3 colors (all but the purple-y shade). I actually love the applicator, and I appreciated the sustainability efforts in designing the packaging. 

I was looking forward to buying refills of each color as the products were running low, but unfortunately, I cannot trust the packaging mechanism not to leak and ruin some of my favorite belongings. One by one, I experienced leaking of these products. First, I stopped carrying the cherry cola shade after it stained the inside of one of my purses. Next, the guava shade leaked through the pocket of my jeans. I thought the iced persimmon shade was safe, as I had made it a few weeks with no leaking, but it ended up leaking all over (and staining) the leather in my car. 

It took me some time to follow up and review because I love Krave Beauty and didn’t want to speak negatively, but I keep seeing this bright red stain on my car’s seat and being reminded lf how disappointing (and frustrating) this product was. I really hope this feedback is taken into account. title: Good but could be improved
body:
I normally don't write reviews, but I'm writing one because I love the idea of this product, and I wish it could be improved.

This lip jelly oil did not hit the mark. Each of the reasons why I love the product has a downside to it: 
1. This lip jelly feels nice and is not sticky on the lip. I like sheer tints, so I love the colors (although I've only purchased the Guava Blush so far), and I don't mind that the color doesn't last. However, the product itself does not stay on your lips. Although I don't expect this kind of lip balm/jelly to last long, I find myself frustrated at having to reapply every hour or so. If I take a sip of water or any drink, the product is virtually gone from my lips.  

2. I love the sustainable packaging that this comes in. One of the reasons why I keep coming back to KraveBeauty is because of Liah and the brand's mission to be more sustainable. However, the packaging leaks after a week of use. I find that the packaging leaks if I place it in any position except upright. This means that I cannot just toss this into my purse like I would for my other lip balm/tints. 

3. I like the idea of the reusable wand, but you have to manhandle it a little bit for it to come out and to put it back in. I did get some product splatter the first time I used it and pulled the wand out too hard. This is preventable if you are careful, though. 

Overall, the product has potential, but there needs to be improvement with the formula and/or the packaging. As it stands, there are better alternatives (not as sustainable, of course) on the market.

title: Super hydrating and comfortable long-lasting wear
body:
First off, I'm a guy and did not really want a high color look from these when wearing them. But I love Krave Beauty products and am always looking for new lip balms or anything to combat my lips going dry. I bought all 4 shades of these so I can see which color would be less "bright" on my lips as I do not really want to look like I have a lip color on when wearing these. 

I was surprised that by just using one application swipe, that they are basically sheer enough that the colors are not really visible enough to look like I am wearing anything on my lips. But they do become more visible when adding a second application (building up the color). The ones that look most natural in general on me are the lighter shades, but I can still get away with the 2 darker shades. 

I also found it surprising that even with only one application, there is enough product on my lips that it feels smooth and hydrated and even lasts a pretty long amount of time even when drinking coffee, etc. Most other lip oils and lip balms from other brands that I've tried before wear away and rub off pretty quickly. I also have to do more than one application of product for most other brands.

The one suggestion I would have for these new lip jellies is a clear version can be released for those of us who want to use these for the hydrating qualiites without wanting any color on the lips.

title: Disappointed with Recent Purchase and Customer Service
body:
I have been a loyal customer of Krave Beauty for years, and I’ve always appreciated their values and commitment to quality. Some of their products, like Great Barrier Relief and Oil La La, have been staples in my skincare routine. I’ve proudly supported this brand and recommended it to others.

However, a recent experience has left me deeply disappointed. I was excited to try the Plumptuous Lip Jelly Oil and ordered the Cherry Cola shade. Unfortunately, the product did not match the color as depicted on the website—it appeared as an unflattering warm brown instead.

I reached out to customer service to explain my situation. I mentioned that I had only opened the package and lightly swatched the product. Since this is a refillable product, I kindly requested to exchange just the color refill for a different shade. Unfortunately, my request was denied outright.

This leaves me with a product I cannot use, and I feel my money has essentially been wasted. While I understand the need for policies, I believe there could have been more flexibility or willingness to address this issue.

Sadly, this experience has tarnished my view of a brand I once admired. For now, I cannot see myself supporting Krave Beauty again, and I encourage others to carefully consider their policies and customer service experiences before purchasing.

title: It’s fine but not worth the price.
body:
Do I love this? Mostly. Do I think it’s worth $20 ($28 after tax and shipping)? Not at all (sorry).

What I love:

* It goes on smoothly and isn’t sticky, big plus.
* Color is very pigmented which is what I was hoping for.
* Though it took some getting used to, the metal applicator and the fact that only a little product comes out on it gives a more controlled application which is especially useful around my double lip lines.
* Seems to hydrate my lips for the most part.
* I can see how other users think the triangle shape is awkward, I kinda dig it though.

What I don’t love:

* The same thing I loved about the metal applicator is also something I don’t love, lol. Because of the little amount that comes out, I have to put it back in the tube several times to cover my whole lips. Looks like you can’t have your cake and eat it too with this one.
* The use of the word “plumping” is misleading and clearly just a buzz word to sell the product which is highly disappointing given Krave’s mission statement about not using gimmicks. Given what is universally understood of what “plumping” lip products are, this isn’t it. At best if you have seriously dry deflated lips then obviously rehydration would make them plumper than they were. But it’s only giving you back what you already had. This isn’t going to give you extra plumping. The term “plumping” never should have been used.
* I’m somewhat new to lip oils but all lip oils I’ve used so far have been lip *stains* and so I expected this to be a lip stain and the color would last long on my lips. Sadly not the case. As one other user reported, 1 hours of color at best and then you have to reapply, and that’s only if you’re not eating. When I ate something, it was gone by the time I was done. So, I wish it was a long lasting lip stain. If it were, that would justify the $20 price tag.
* I licked my lips and WHOOEE it tastes nasty.

Overall, it’s a fine product and if I got it as a gift, I would 100% use it happily. But at $20, I get it’s got all kinds of fancy ingredients in it and the whole “sustainability” thing, but it doesn’t outperform anything else I have that’s significantly cheaper. Even with the refill at $16, that’s still too rich for my blood. And in this economy, I’m more about affordability and frugality than anything else. 

So those are my two honest cents. I would not repurchase this.

title: Guava Blush
body:
Guava blush gives a pretty flush of color to my lips and the formula leaves your lips moisturized for a long time (also not sticky).  I can't tell if it's the color or the formula but it looks like I just exfoliated my lips and put on lipgloss (which I like).  I'm not sure if that's supposed to be the "plumping" effect but it doesn't make your lips look bigger, just freshly exfoliated.  I wish it smelled like something sweet (like vanilla or cocoa butter) but that's not really a turn off to me for a lip product.  I have a love/hate relationship with the design and shape of the product.  It's a beautiful and unique tube to look at (idk why but I love that it's clear on the top).  I love the size because I won't lose it and can find it easily in my bag, but the triangle shape feels awkward when holding the applicator.  I love that the applicator is metal and the shape is perfect to apply the gloss on my bottom lip but the shape also makes it awkward to apply on my upper lip.  Also, there's a lot of suction/tight opening for the applicator.  I have to put in slightly more effort to pull it out or put it back in.  So that awkwardness of holding it and using it doesn't make me reach for it as much.  I want to use it more because I really like the formula but instinctually I reach for something that's easier to use and I don't have to think about it.  Overall, the formula is great but the design and ergonomics can be improved :)

title: New Go-To Lip Product
body:
Disclaimer: I received this product for free in exchange for my unbiased opinion.

I have always struggled with extremely dry lips. My problem has always been finding a good lip product that wasn't too heavy/sticky that would still provide a bit of color along with hydration. This product is almost exactly what I've been looking for. 

I got the shade Iced Persimmon, and it's the perfect shade for my fair/light skin. It's like a shear reddish/pinkish color (I'm bad describing colors :P) that I love. The applicator is one of the best I've ever used. Most lip oils/jellies/glosses have the usual doe-foot applicator where some of the product gets absorbed, but this Plumptuous Lip Jelly uses a metal applicator where none of the product gets absorbed and I can apply the lip jelly with more precision (and it also has the benefit of the metal feeling a bit cool to the touch, so it also feels nice to put on). The lip jelly itself is wonderful. I'm never one who reaches for plumping lip products because I don't like the stinging feeling, but this jelly does give a subtle plumping effect without any of the stinging. It also definitely helps nourish my very dry lips. It feels nice and hydrating when I apply it without it being sticky. The only reason I'm not giving this 5 stars is because I do have to reapply quite often. Within 1-2 hours I feel my lips getting dry again. (This is true of basically every lip product I've ever tried though, so it's not something in particular about this jelly; it is what's keeping it from being a perfect 5 out of 5 for me though). 

Overall, this lip jelly has now become my go-to, everyday lip product.

title: Nice simple FA safe moisturizer; not enough for winter; wish it was in a tube instead of a jar
body:
I had tried Oat So Simple previously and liked it well enough as a lightweight moisturizer for warmer weather, but didn’t repurchase because I couldn’t justify the cost for just a basic moisturizer (and I also much prefer products in a tube vs a jar). 

In the meantime I’ve been trying to treat rosacea, and I’ve temporarily switched to fungal-acne-safe products just in case malassezia may be at play as well. I decided to use Oat So Simple again due to the fact that it’s fungal-acne safe (no oils or fatty acids), and I already know it gets along well with my skin.

Just like the first time, it’s not bad - it’s very lightweight, not greasy or heavy, doesn’t further irritate my redness or cause breakouts, and plays well with other products AM and PM. It’s definitely not heavy enough for a winter moisturizer, especially at night - 20 mins after applying it unfortunately feels like my face is bone dry again - so I’ve had to mix in a little dab of Aquaphor to make it more occlusive.

As much as I dislike products in a jar, I do appreciate that Krave offers a refill rather than having to buy plastic jar after plastic jar. If I continue using this, I may buy my own glass pump bottle and just put the refill in that.

Overall it’s a perfectly fine very lightweight moisturizer that’s fungal acne safe, though probably not moisturizing enough for dry winter air for most people. Haven’t decided yet if it’s worth repurchasing at $30 + shipping when there are other basic lightweight moisturizers on the market that could do the job.

body:
I have spent my whole life looking for different face products. I usually use half a bottle of something before I give up on it— not only do I have sensitive skin, but I have issues with certain textures. Finding a skin routine and products has been a nightmare.

I found this stuff during the first round of quarantine, and I have been buying it ever since. It's lightweight, doesn't make me feel oily, and genuinely soothes whatever I have going on. I avoid putting it on the occasional breakout (I'd be lying if I said small bouts of depression didn't encourage me to fall asleep without washing my face for a week at a time once in a while) BUT if I wanted to put this on a breakout, I wouldn't be worried in the slightest that it would make it worse, it's that light.

Just remember to use a small amount! I use maybe a pea-size amount, a little less, every night and I'm good to go. The jar lasts me roughly two months.

I'm leaving this review right now because I'm here to buy another container! (waitlisted btw :( rip)

product: Oat So Simple Water Cream Refill Pouch
title: The Only Moisturizer I Can Use Around My Eyes
body: I have sensitive, combination, acne prone skin with some ingredient sensitivities and occasional seb derm flare ups. Finding good quality, gentle, non-irritating, non-comedogenic, FA-safe and limited-ingredient products is essential to my skincare routine. My eye area is especially prone to inflammation and irritation and I'm able to use this product around my eyes with no issue. It doesn't keep my skin moisturized for as long as some other creams I've used (probably because it isn't as heavy and occlusive), and is. missing one or two ingredients that would make it an all in one HG for me like ceramides, but the limited ingredient list and light weight is probably why I am able to use the product around sensitive areas without issue unlike those other creams I mentioned, so I'm happy with the formulation as-is so far. Another review I read off-site mentioned that it's a great "base" moisturizer to add other products to and customize it to your specific needs, and I agree. Currently I'm starting a prescription retinoid and needing a lot more moisture, so I'm using this exclusively as an eye cream, and since I need some more occlusion, I apply a very thin layer of petrolatum on top to seal it in. I could also see this product working well for someone with an oilier skin type regardless of sensitivities, or someone living in a humid climate looking for a more lightweight moisturizer.

title: Excellent for face skin but surprisingly, and equally, phenomenal for scalp care too!
body:
I initially purchased this product for my face to add a thin layer as my final step in my nighttime skincare regimen. I had been looking for a facial oil to help with my winter dryness. GBR is a holy grail product for me so unsurprisingly, the Tamanu oil worked very well in nourishing my skin and adding an extra juicy oomph. Literally takes two drops for the coverage I want. Zero complaints there.

However, where this really shone for me was in scalp care. I decided to try it out as a prewash oil, concentrating on my temples where I have more hair thinning- I really liked the way my scalp felt after and that was enough initially. Did this twice a week, about a dropper or two full, (letting it marinate for a few hours prior to shampooing) for over a month now and the REGROWTH!! I easily have twice the amount of baby hairs, it's shocking how amazing my scalp has responded to it. My husband and mother in law have commented on separate occasions about my thickening hairline. And I know it was this product because it is the only thing I changed in my hair/scalp routine- I'm not on any oral supplements either. I am loving the experience and results for my hair so much that I have completely stopped using it on my face so I can preserve every precious drop for my hair journey. I am truly hoping this is added to the permanent KB collection because omg I will be quite devastated when it is empty.

title: Component/packaging could be improved upon
body:
As a fan of great barrier relief, I was excited for this to launch and bought it when it released. I’ve been using it since then and have found that the oil seeps out after I twist the bottle closed, and I found myself wiping the excess around the base of mouth of the bottle where the dropper and bottle meet. The top of the dropper is also turning green like it’s absorbing the oil, which only bothers me because that means I can’t use the oil that’s been absorbed lol. Maybe all of that is due to the nature of shaking the bottle well before use as per the instructions? 

As a face oil, I think it’s thicker than I am used to, which is OK. Often times, I mix it with the peach and lily face oil, which isn’t as thick in consistency, so that it applies easier on my face. By itself, it can feel like the right amount you need isn’t enough because the consistency is so thick it doesn’t really spread across your face in an effortless way in the way a lighter face oil or moisturizer would. 

If the component could be improved upon to prevent accidental leakage, I would give back one star. Not sure if it’s possible to adjust the consistency without additional ingredients, but I would give back one star if the consistency wasn’t as thick as that would increase my user experience.

title: I ADORE this oil - Holy Grail
body:
Ok, so first of all, KB has amazing customer service! I had some difficulties with delivery and they swiftly responded and refunded me without fuss! I appreciated it very much! 
Alright, now for the review of the oil! For reference, my skin type is dry leaning, sensitive, and acne-prone. 
This was my first KB product ever. I've never tried GBR or anything, but I was very intrigued by Tamanu oil. First, the color is beautiful and while most hate the smell, I actually love it! It's so earthy and nutty and comforting to me. The texture is very thick, but not too heavy. It's also more grippy instead of slippy like most oils. 
When i first used this oil, my skin was actually pretty clear, so at first I couldn't say anything about whether it helped soothe my acne. But I could definitely tell how moisturizing it was! It was like a blanket for my dry skin, especially since it's getting colder out. 
A couple days after I started using the oil (day and night), I got one of those annoying pimples in the crease of my nose. At first I was so sad because I thought it was from the oil, but I decided to forge forward anyway and used the oil as a spot treatment for the pimple. And you know how annoying and stubborn those nose pimples are, and how they last FOREVER. But lo and behold, just two days after it popped up, it was completely gone and soothed, not even a mark left over! And this oil was the only thing different with my routine. I was absolutely amazed. 
So now I've been consistently using this oil after my moisturizer every morning and night for about two weeks, and my skin is LOVING it! My skin is so soft and smooth, and even a clearer and less red. It's such a nice comforting oil for my skin.
I've even started putting a couple drops in my body lotion, and my bacne and bacne scars are already improving so much! (And because of that, I just ordered the KB body lotion with Tamanu oil) 
 This oil is now at holy grail status for me, which is not something I say lightly. Please let this become a permanent product!

I know some people have a hard time with the scent, but hopefully it grows onto them! I’ve grown to adore the scent since I’ve been using the serum every night for a few years now. Please give this cream a chance if you’re suffering from eczema-related problems!!

title: Sooo happy with this product that I bought more the next day….
body: I am def not one a person to leave reviews but this product????….. I seriously had to…. I bought this for my fiance. His body was covered head to toe with poison ivy or elm or some kinda nasty poison plant from cutting down this massive tree that feel on our house from our neighbors yard… we got the reaction to stop and he was left with these dry itchy patches. Perfect excuse to get him to buy my skincare!!!…. It worked great on him. He keeps its on his nightstand. Because of his job his skin can really take a beating…. I ordered 2 more the next day because I love it soooo much…. Now I am not saying this will work for you…. This is only the experiences that we had. I gave up on finding a body lotion that absorbed into my skin instead of just sitting on top and making my skin feel slimy… this absorbs soooo well!. It makes the itchiness go away immediately!!! Now the smell…IMO— it didn’t bother me either way at first…. It smells like a natural product without and scent added…. I can appreciate that because they say fragrance can be irritating and as a nurse we were not allowed to wear scented lotions or perfumes for the patients. I walked into our bedroom the other night and I asked my fiancé if he just used the lotion because i thought i could smell it. He said no. I thought it was the lotion but it was the wild flowers mixed in with the roses he bought me for Valentine’s Day. So if I had to compare it to another scent that would be it. It does fade as it absorbs…. I also want to add that the KP bumps on my arms are hardly visible and I can not feel them as much. Most often times after I shave and apply a lotion afterward the ingrown hairs on the back of my legs tend to get really angry…. So far so good…. They have not been there… I definitely would purchase this again and will continue to do so!!! Hope this helps!

title: Healed my Dyshidrotic Eczema!!!
body:
!!Vegan Approved!! 
I cannot give this product more praise if I wanted to!! It’s magic in a bottle for my Eczema!!!

For years in the past, I spent so much money on eczema products, only to find none of them helped. It wasn’t till I was 26 that I finally found a product that did (Goldbond Healing Hand Cream). But this year when I decided to become Vegan, I knew it was just a matter of time till that bottle I had would run out and I would have to restart that journey of finding a lotion that would heal my eczema. Now at 29, I was 6 months into my Vegan journey when I had a eczema breakout on my hands. Of course the bottle I had of goldbond was literally almost done already. 🫣 And stubborn as I am, I didn’t want to cave and support a company that isn’t cruelty-free and especially that the specific product I used didn’t claim it’s vegan. So I did what any good vegan would and restarted my lotion journey.

At first I tried Hempz, then vitamin E oil, and then I remembered trying Krave Beauty skincare a couple years ago (for their SPF) and I remembered they were vegan and cruelty free, but I didn’t remember them having a lotion back then. 

THANKFUL I CHECKED!!! Omg, in one day I noticed my eczema calming down, and in a week it’s completely smooth like normal skin again (in the pic, sry I didn’t take a before). I am soooooooo happy I found this. Because In the past, eczema marketed lotions didn’t ever work for me, I didn’t bother trying to find one marketed for it this time, and I’m so glad I found this!!!

That being said, it is on the oily side of lotions, if that’s an issue for you, just be aware. I don’t particularly like oily lotions, but if it heals my eczema, I love oily lotions. 🤣

Anyways, I hope this helps someone. 🙂

title: Life Saver in one of the hardest times of my life
body:
I never write reviews but this time I really felt inspired to. I've been dealing with some really scary and rare liver problems for the past several months. This week the itchiness and skin discomfort got out of hand (something that happens with liver disease). It's common for people to experience suicidal ideation when dealing with this itch. "Itch" doesn't really describe what it is. For 28 hours straight (no sleep) I felt like my body was on fire at the worst of it. Really excruciating. I've been using the face serum version of this for three years and noticed that my face wasn't itching nearly as much as the rest of my body. So I ordered this and have gone through a bottle in three days. But so worth it. The lesions from scratching are healing so much faster than they would otherwise. And it's been my only source of relief. THANK YOU, Krave Beauty. Your tamanu oil  products rock my world! Obviously very happy with the great barrier relief too, since I've been using it every am and pm for three years. My dry skin loves it and it's the best part of my skin care routine.

Just ordered two more with expedited shipping because this is just so good for me right now. To be clear, if you're dealing with cholestatic pruritus, it didn't remove the itch, but it gave me a lot of soothing relief in some of the hardest hours of my life and 's helping my skin heal faster.

title: Great lotion, not so great packaging
body:
A little overpriced, but overall an effective moisturizer that I'll repurchase. It's rich, hydrating, and nourishing. But because its texture is more lotion-y than creamy, it sinks into the skin easier than other moisturizers with similar ingredients.

I have to knock off a star for the packaging though. It's not accessible. Once you get to about 40% full, it takes some muscle to squeeze the moisturizer out. And when it goes down to 20% full, I have to use scissors and cut the back end to get the rest out. Each tube is pretty small too, so I have to do this way too often. An easy solution would be to create a jumbo size version that uses a tub and/or pump instead of a squeeze tube.

title: Love this body lotion!
body: Absorbs into the skin quickly because of its light texture, helps calm down redness on my body, and you can apply multiple layers without it getting sticky or too thick. I've been using it since end of May '22 (on my fifth bottle as of today) and it has been keeping my skin hydrated during all the seasons in NY. I don't have super dry skin but do have mild eczema + psoriasis on my elbows/knees/neck and keratosis pilaris on my arms/legs. This has helped resolve the former skin issues but hasn't repaired my kp entirely (it has smoothed it out a little and prevented it from getting worse though!). Things to note: It does take slightly more to moisturize your skin than other body lotions I've tried. Also, if you're sensitive to or don't like natural scents, you may not enjoy this as much – I don't mind the scent at all and it hasn't changed the scent of any perfumes I've used.

title: Everyday Staple
body:
In my personal experience with Krave Beauty Great Body Relief, I can confidently assert that it is a truly remarkable product. As someone who has been plagued with dehydrated and itchy skin, particularly on my legs, I have found this product to be extremely effective in providing the necessary hydration and relief.

The lightweight formula of the product is one of its greatest strengths. It penetrates the skin easily and quickly, leaving no greasy or heavy residue, and provides an immediate soothing sensation. I am thrilled with the overall performance of this product, which has left my skin feeling soft, smooth, and silky.

While the scent of Great Body Relief is certainly unique and slightly medicinal/herbal, it is not overpowering and quickly fades away. I appreciate that this product is not loaded with artificial fragrances, which can often irritate sensitive skin.

As someone who has tried countless body lotions and balms, I can confidently say that Krave Beauty Great Body Relief is now a staple in my skincare routine. I have already purchased multiple tubes of this product, and will continue to do so in the future. I highly recommend this product to anyone struggling with dry, itchy skin, or anyone looking for a nourishing, lightweight body lotion. With its key ingredient of 5% Tamanu oil, this product provides a powerful and effective solution for all your skincare needs.

title: Great for Mild Eczema, not for locking in hydration
body: I actually really like this product! I've been developing mild eczema on my forearms and fingers, and nothing seemed to really help. I'd been using Eucerin before this, which helped mildly but required me to put it on almost every night. However, with one application of GBR (Great Body Relief) all the little eczema patches on my forearms actually went away! I don't use GBR every night, but I do find that the eczema on my forearms hasn't returned. I saw some of the other reviews saying that this product isn't good for winter, etc, but I will say that I don't think this product is the best at locking in hydration. Rather, I think it kind of serves a similar effect to Great Barrier Relief, which provides some moisture and relief to irritated or otherwise sensitive skin. I think it may work best if used in tandem with something else that can seal in moisture. But all in all, I personally recommend this product!

body: AHAs, in general, are too harsh for my face, but I still love using Kale-Lalu-yAHA as my go to body exfoliation toner. I have also had amazing success using the toner on my feet on pedicure days to get baby smooth and soft feet.  I apply the toner generously after washing my feet/using the pumice stone, and seal the toner in with a heavy moisturizer/balm, and the results are amazing! The toner has greatly improved the quality of my at home pedicures. The extra soothing and moisture from the supporting ingredients in the toner have been awesome for helping my sensitive skin tolerate exfoliation, and I could not recommend it enough, even to people like me who do not tolerate AHAs well on their face.

title: Be careful If you have sensitive skin!
body: I really wanted to love this product. The claims of it being gentle exfoliant convinced me to try it. Cut to this product being way to strong and destroying my skin barrier. Oh how I wish I patch tested first. I used this before bed and woke up to quite a bit of redness on my chin. I dealt with extremely sensitive and reactive skin for weeks after using since my skin had been over exfoliated. I became sensitive to my skincare products I had used for years without any prior irritation, especially mineral sunscreens. It took about a month or two to get my skin back in shape by going back to basics, gentle cleanser, barrier repairing moisturizer, and skipping SPF ( I know!) until my skin was no longer irritated and reactive. Please patch test first if you don’t regularly use chemical exfoliants and have more sensitive skin.
